$description: Closed motion vocabulary. Techniques on the original: CSS transitions/keyframes, setInterval timers, requestAnimationFrame, IntersectionObserver. No framer-motion, GSAP or Lottie. The animate-in/fade-in/slide-in-* classes are INERT on the original and are not patterns. schema enum + sections must equal this key set (verify_all.py).

animated-webp-mask-once.description: Animated WebP used as a mask that plays once (loop count 1) then rests on its final frame.

arrow-nudge-hover.description: Trailing arrow moves 4px via the CSS translate property over 200ms on hover.

count-up-on-view.description: 1400ms easeOutCubic count-up at IntersectionObserver threshold 0.4; skipped if already in view on load.

demo-loop-on-view.description: Timer-driven demo loop started by IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.3). Multiplayer 1400/2600ms; sandbox phases [350,1400,250,900,900,2800]; orchestration 450/500/2800ms and LOOPS forever.

fade-in-on-mount.description: Opacity 0 to 1 on first rAF, 500ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1).

hover-color.description: Colour/background/border change on hover or focus, 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) (prose links: opacity .8 over 200ms).

hover-opacity.description: Group hover drops meta/title opacity to .7 over 150ms.

icon-swap-hover.description: Download icon and arrow-down swap with 8px vertical travel over 200ms.

instant-hover.description: Hover state with NO transition (header Download, hero Get Conductor, pricing and brandkit buttons).

measuredFrom.quote: Pricing buttons have **no transition class**, so their hover is instant.

instant-toggle.description: Open/close with no animation (mobile menu, download dialog).

measuredFrom.quote: Net effect: the dialog appears and disappears instantly

reveal-stagger-on-view.description: Per-card fade + 16px rise, 500ms ease-out, 50ms stagger, IntersectionObserver threshold 0.1, fires once.

scramble-cycle.description: Hero H1 phrase cycle every 3000ms with a left-to-right a-z character scramble (~470-650ms).

scroll-mask-nav.description: CSS scroll-driven edge mask on the header nav when it overflows.

scroll-spy.description: TOC scroll-spy: every heading in view is active; SVG track and 4px dot follow.

measuredFrom.quote: Every heading currently inside the viewport is active.

shimmer-loader.description: SVG dot loader shimmer keyframes, 916.67ms infinite (disabled under reduced motion).

sticky-meta.description: Changelog meta column sticks at top 96px from 768px.

measuredFrom.quote: sticks at **top 96px** while the article scrolls

tooltip-hover.description: Avatar tooltip: opacity + 4px translate over 150ms on hover/focus-visible.

typewriter-terminal.description: Typewriter text with blinking block cursor (530ms) on the download/404 terminal.

video-autoplay-loop.description: Muted autoplay looping video inside changelog entries.

reducedMotionFallbacks.static-no-motion-needed: Nothing animates in the default state, so the reduced-motion state is identical.
reducedMotionFallbacks.final-state-no-motion: Jump straight to the final state; timers and loops stop.
reducedMotionFallbacks.poster-or-first-frame: Show the video poster / first frame instead of autoplaying.
